hotel.name: Celina of The Sea — Family Suite Connecting
hotel.address: Embark Lot 41A, Tuan Chau International Marina, Ha Long (Lan Ha Bay overnight)

tip: 1-night cruise IS the attraction — do not book a separate Ha Long day tour. Lounge 11:15–11:45 · tender ~12:00–12:30. Confirm meals for all 5 + $160 extra bed for 8yo.

attractions.name: Celina of The Sea 2D1N (the cruise itself)
attractions.shortDescription: Lan Ha Bay overnight on a new luxury ship — kayaking, cooking class, sunset party, meals, and cabin are the core product.
attractions.whyKids: Overnight beats a day cruise; activities optional; life jackets; large-ship facilities (pool, mini-golf, play area).
attractions.reviewSummary: Ship new (~early 2026); thin Tripadvisor base — OTA praise for cabins/service; 1-nighters feel short by nature. Don’t overweight agent ‘4.9’ marketing.
